DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.label: watchtower
DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.description: An elevated lookout overlooking the surrounding area.\n\nActivation requirement: at least one non-downed resident at this outpost with Shooting 10 or higher. One qualified resident can operate all watchtowers in this outpost. While enabled, each tower adds 10 defense to this outpost and friendly outposts on immediately adjacent tiles. Bonuses from multiple towers stack.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.label: temporary defenses
DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.description: Earthworks, firing steps and improvised barricades provide a modest defensive position.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.label: fortifications
DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.description: Hardened firing positions and prepared strongpoints provide reliable protection against attack.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.label: mortar emplacement
DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.description: A permanent mortar position built into the outpost perimeter. Range tables, prepared ammunition stores and hardened firing positions allow skilled residents to deliver mortar fire on nearby targets.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.label: ammunition dump
DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.description: A protected shell store that adds three rounds to every bombardment fired by this outpost.
